Subject:Notice
Attachment:Form

Dear Staff,

We recently engaged a team from Fenwick Assurance, a consultancy that specialises in the handling of confidential documents, to carry out a review of the way we work. They have found that there is a danger of client material being seen by people outside the agency. To deal with this, some employees will no longer be allowed to keep working files on their own personal drives.

If you belong to the legal translation department, you will be issued an encrypted drive for client material. The device comes with our current protection software already installed. Please complete the attached request form and send it to Marisol Peña in the IT team by August 18. When you meet her to collect the drive, she will take you through its encryption features and make certain that you can operate them correctly.

Further measures will be brought in over the next few months, and these will reach other departments as well. I know that I can rely on all of you to follow them carefully so that our clients’ interests are protected.

Sincerely,

Anna Novotná
Managing Director, Meridian Language Services
